description: This source file defines the HttpService class, which provides methods for making HTTP requests (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE) with JSON serialization in a Blazor .NET project. It acts as a wrapper around HttpClient to facilitate API interactions and includes error handling with toast notifications.

classes.name: HttpService
classes.description: A service class for managing HTTP requests with automatic JSON serialization/deserialization and error handling for use in a Blazor application.

methods.name: HttpGet
methods.description: Performs an HTTP GET request and deserializes the JSON response into a specified type.

methods.name: HttpDelete
methods.description: Performs an HTTP DELETE request for a resource identified by an ID and deserializes the response.

methods.name: HttpPost
methods.description: Performs an HTTP POST request with serialized JSON data and deserializes the response; shows a toast message on error.

methods.name: HttpPut
methods.description: Performs an HTTP PUT request with serialized JSON data and deserializes the response; shows a toast message on error.

methods.name: ToJson
methods.description: Serializes an object into a JSON StringContent for use in HTTP requests.

methods.name: FromHttpResponseMessage
methods.description: Deserializes the HttpResponseMessage content into a specified type.
